headline: This release adds support for animated theme ornaments and round switches, along with fixes for vendor interactions in instances and emptied item slots.

entries.title: Theme ornaments and round switch style
entries.details: Themes can now feature animated decorative ornaments along bag edges with ambient swaying, pulsing, and spinning effects. Themes can also use an alternative round toggle switch style for settings controls.

entries.title: Error when interacting with vendors in instances
entries.details: Fixed an error when opening merchant windows inside dungeons and raids where NPC identity values are restricted.

entries.title: Error when recalculating bags after emptying a slot
entries.details: Fixed an error that could occur when bag contents recalculated immediately after a slot was emptied by selling, consuming, or equipping an item.
